title: Construction contract 2026-001
text: The City of Toronto awarded a construction contract for road repairs on Bloor Street, covering asphalt resurfacing and sidewalk reconstruction between Bathurst Street and Ossington Avenue.

title: Road maintenance agreement 2026-014
text: Road maintenance agreement covering Bloor Street and Danforth Avenue, including pothole repair, snow clearing, and street sweeping for the 2026 season.

title: Building permit BP-2026-77
text: Building permit issued for a mixed-use development at 200 Queen Street West with retail at grade and residential above.

title: Council minutes 2026-02-05
text: City council approved the 2026 operating budget after debate over library funding, transit fares, and emergency shelter capacity.

title: Audit report: procurement review
text: The auditor general reviewed procurement practices for large construction contracts and flagged gaps in competitive tendering for road repairs.

title: Snow removal contract SR-2026-3
text: Mississauga awarded a snow removal contract for the 2026 winter season covering arterial roads and transit routes.

title: Committee recommendation CR-12/2026
text: General committee recommended amendments to the zoning bylaw for the downtown core, raising height limits near transit stations.

title: Development permit DP-2026-118
text: Vancouver issued a development permit for a rental tower on Kingsway with required affordable housing units.

title: Capital plan 2026: water and sewers
text: The capital plan funds water main replacement and sewer separation across Vancouver neighbourhoods through 2029.

title: Transit route expansion TR-88
text: Calgary transit approved route TR-88 connecting the airport to the downtown core with fifteen-minute peak service.

title: LERT amendment bylaw 2026-44
text: Ottawa city council amended the land evaluation and review tool criteria for urban expansion boundaries.

title: Water main replacement WMR-2026-07
text: Hamilton will replace a cast-iron water main on Barton Street to reduce boil-water advisories.

title: Housing acceleration fund application
text: Halifax submitted a housing acceleration fund application proposing zoning reform near transit corridors and secondary suites citywide.

title: 2026 operating budget deliberations
text: Winnipeg council debated police funding, library hours, and transit fares in operating budget deliberations for 2026.

title: LRT expansion valley line update
text: Edmonton reported progress on the valley line southeast LRT, with station construction at Davies and Millgate.

title: Procurement notice RFP-2026-09
text: Brampton issued a request for proposals for fleet electrification of transit buses, closing in ninety days.

title: Climate action plan progress report
text: Victoria reported emissions reductions from building retrofits and noted risks to the sea-level adaptation budget.

title: Riverfront park master plan
text: Saskatoon adopted a riverfront park master plan with funding for trails, lighting, and riverbank stabilization.

title: Bike lane project BL-2026-2
text: Toronto tendered a bike lane project on Bloor Street west, with protected lanes from Avenue Road to Shaw Street.

title: Emergency preparedness review 2026
text: The emergency preparedness review recommended backup power for transit signals and expanded shelter capacity during extreme weather.

title: RSS core module
text: Ingests federal RSS news feeds for press releases and announcements from departments and agencies.

title: Parliamentary committees module
text: Tracks parliamentary committee evidence, meeting transcripts, notices, and witness lists from the House of Commons and Senate.

title: Canada Gazette module
text: Ingests Canada Gazette parts I, II and III for regulations, statutory instruments, and proclamations.

title: Corporate registry module
text: Covers corporate registry filings, director changes, and annual returns from provincial corporate registries.

title: Lobbying influence module
text: Monitors lobbying registrations, communication reports, and in-house lobbyist activity under the Lobbying Act.

title: Municipal records module
text: Collects municipal council decisions, budgets, bylaws, and contract notices from municipal open data portals across Canada.

title: Oversight bodies module
text: Follows auditor general reports, commissioner investigations, and officer-of-parliament findings with citation-ready evidence.

title: Provincial legislatures module
text: Aggregates provincial Hansard records, bills, and committee business from all ten provinces and three territories.

title: Federal procurement module
text: Tracks federal procurement contracts, tender awards, and standing offers from buyandsell.gc.ca.

title: Energy regulator module
text: Collects energy regulator decisions, tolls hearings, and market reports from the Canada Energy Regulator and provincial boards.
